decisions.selected: Post one to three Mermaid diagrams in the triggering issue or pull-request thread.
decisions.rationale: The adoption workflow explicitly requires posting GitHub-compatible diagrams in the original thread; generation and volume do not establish that result.

decisions.selected: Recorded subject case, with exact workflow-run URL comment search as the historical fallback.
alternatives: Use run ID as the opportunity
Assign all repository discussions in the run window
decisions.rationale: The workflow acts on its triggering issue or pull request. The exact footer URL uniquely recovers an otherwise absent historical subject without treating unrelated discussion as assigned.

decisions.selected: A github-actions[bot] comment with an exact run URL and Mermaid fence.
decisions.rationale: This is direct, repository-local evidence of the required posted diagram and rejects unrelated or user-authored diagrams.

decisions.selected: Binary attainment: accepted diagram comment present is 1; absent on a known subject is 0.
decisions.rationale: The adoption intent requires a posted diagram, not a quantity or stylistic quality level.

decisions.selected: Seven days after run creation, with cutoff capped at maturity.
decisions.rationale: The fixed window allows delayed safe-output publication while making replays stable.
The workflow was added in its adoption commit, so no pre-adoption Archie-run subject and result pairs exist to score under this contract.

uncertainties.description: GitHub search or comment retrieval can be unavailable or may not index a footer immediately.
uncertainties.mitigation: Return null rather than zero when retrieval fails; use the fixed seven-day horizon for stable replay.

uncertainties.description: The adoption workflow does not specify an evidence delay.
uncertainties.mitigation: Freeze a seven-day maturation window and cap all observations at it.
